Multi
■ Over Drive—Light x1 and Nature x1 (When you summon this creature, you may tap another 1 light and 1 nature card in your mana zone. If you do, this creature gets the following OD ability.)
:OD When cards are put into your graveyard from your hand or battle zone this turn, you may put them into your mana zone instead.
